bug_semantics: The unauthenticated /echo and /api/echo routes reach the same echo handler. With BackendURL empty, the handler reads an attacker-controlled request body and writes it verbatim to the response without setting Content-Type or X-Content-Type-Options. Go MIME-sniffs an HTML-leading body as text/html, so a cross-origin auto-submitted POST can execute reflected script in the podinfo origin.
flaw_origin: Commit 153f4dce454790c7850fa19e089eebc008a3abab is the atomic surviving first writer of the vulnerable echoHandler: it added pkg/api/echo.go that reads the request body and, when BackendURL is empty, writes it with only X-Color and status 202 and no Content-Type or nosniff. Immediate parent 4c8d11cc3e591cc9f174ffd222646bf2439631a8 has no echo handler. An earlier 2018-01-08 /echo body write in 1dde723cf969ef97ada5b7e6c5e9de43aed063f4 was deleted in d26b7a96d9b4cf12b762cd1a24cede8fcfee4e12 and is not the surviving public BIC. Later mux routing, multi-backend JSON aggregation, package moves, and reformats preserved that else-branch write and are not first causal writers.
ai_marker: BIC object 153f4dce454790c7850fa19e089eebc008a3abab has author and committer Stefan Prodan <stefan.prodan@gmail.com> on 2018-08-20, message 'Add echo handler with backend propagation', and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot, or generator trailer. The Claude Opus 4.7 Co-Authored-By trailer is only on fix-side test commit 6210e0a92062f450a16dc0bdd90b9ef476608456 and is not a BIC signal. Named human authorship on the surviving BIC supports NOT_AI.
evidence: The CVE.org record is PUBLISHED and identifies podinfo <= 6.11.2 as affected; GHSA-q23m-vm9r-5745 describes the reflected XSS in /echo and /api/echo and identifies the missing explicit Content-Type and nosniff headers.

git show of 153f4dce454790c7850fa19e089eebc008a3abab is a single-parent add of pkg/api/echo.go whose else branch does w.Write(body) without Content-Type. git blame -w -C -C on 6.11.2 pkg/api/http/echo.go attributes that else-branch write to this commit. Parent 4c8d11cc3e591cc9f174ffd222646bf2439631a8 has no echoHandler and no body reflection.

The BIC commit object records Stefan Prodan as both author and committer on 2018-08-20 with message 'Add echo handler with backend propagation' and has no AI, assistant, bot, co-author, or generated-code marker.

Tag 6.11.2 resolves to b501abd1f0f2acf49c39f2d9cd47b460578d87f0, contains the BIC, does not contain b65271f0d98bde04670c74bcfabf767ede9ae51c, and its echo direct-response branch still writes body with no safe content headers.

Direct fix b65271f0d98bde04670c74bcfabf767ede9ae51c has parent 9f4969c2c84338b026300dafb55698e05b1d6fbc and adds application/octet-stream, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and a restrictive Content-Security-Policy immediately before the body write.

Merge carrier cbebb20fd48588d36fc7ff3e874c128eb89692f4 has parents 9f4969c2c84338b026300dafb55698e05b1d6fbc and 6210e0a92062f450a16dc0bdd90b9ef476608456. The PR branch consists of direct-fix member b65271f0d98bde04670c74bcfabf767ede9ae51c followed by test-only member 6210e0a92062f450a16dc0bdd90b9ef476608456; the Claude co-author trailer is confined to that fix-side test member and is not evidence about the 2018 BIC.

The primary's 1dde723 introducer is a non-surviving pre-rewrite body echo, so introducer_sha/parent must be 153f4dc/4c8d11c.
